record.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:82 — Guest emails are not lowercased before comparison against attendees and BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS, so case variants bypass both checks at the API boundary

adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, blacklistedGuestEmails are normalized to lowercase (`.map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`), but incoming `guests` are used as-is when filtering (`guest === attendee.email` and `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`). Since `guest` is never lowercased, a case-variant like `Test@Example.com` can bypass both the existing-attendee duplicate check and the blacklist check if stored/blacklisted values are lowercase.
